body.en: The campus screening starts soon. Coffee, a projector lens, and the final film reel are still on the way. You are the last courier on shift.
body.zh: 钟楼广场马上开场。咖啡、镜头和胶片还在路上。你是今晚最后一位快递员。

body.en: The lab lent you a Borrower. Hold Q to slow devices with blue time tags. You move normally. Your delivery clock keeps ticking.
body.zh: 实验室借给你一枚借秒器。按住 Q，让带蓝色时间标签的装置减速；你照常行动。订单倒计时不会变慢。

body.en: Follow the package and destination markers. Collect your next order where you finish the last. If something goes wrong, retry the current order.
body.zh: 沿着包裹与目的地标记前进。送达后在同一地点领取下一单。出错可以重试当前订单。

text.en: WASD to move. Move the mouse to look around. Reach the marked spot.
text.zh: WASD 移动，鼠标转动视角。走到标记位置。

text.en: Press Space to jump over the low step.
Hold Q to slow the blue-tagged cart. Cross while it moves slowly.
text.zh: 按住 Q 让蓝色标签运输车减速，趁它变慢时通过。

text.en: Ready! Your delivery clock starts when you collect an order.
text.zh: 准备好了！领取订单后才开始计时。

brief.en: Bring the coffee box to the stand before the screening. Watch for delivery carts crossing the square.
brief.zh: 把保温箱送到咖啡摊。广场上的运输车正在穿行，留意空隙。

delivered.en: Coffee is ready. Next up: the projector lens.
delivered.zh: 咖啡准备好了。下一单：投影镜头。

brief.en: Take the lens through the garden. Slow the lift to give yourself more time to board, or follow the longer ramp.
brief.zh: 把镜头送过花园。减慢升降台可延长登台时机，也可以走较长的坡道。

delivered.en: The projector is ready. One last reel to deliver.
delivered.zh: 投影机准备好了。还差最后一卷胶片。

brief.en: The whole square is waiting for this reel. Choose your route, cross the cart lanes, and save a charge for the lift.
brief.zh: 全场都在等这一卷。选择路线、穿过车道，并为升降台安排好借秒器的使用时机。

delivered.en: All three deliveries made. Time to take your seat.
delivered.zh: 三份急件全部送达。现在，轮到你入座了。

run_only.en: Progress lasts for this session. Quitting starts a new run.
run_only.zh: 进度在本次运行中保留，退出后重新开始。

ending_body.en: The film begins. Your three delivery stamps make one ticket. Tonight, there is a seat for you too.
ending_body.zh: 放映开始。三枚配送邮戳，拼成了你的电影票。今晚，也有一个座位属于你。

poster_joke.en: Do not use the Borrower to extend exams.
poster_joke.zh: 请勿用借秒器延长考试。
